description: Redesign Solana Trader v1 discovery pipeline. Replace Nansen-first discovery (98% of signals score 0) with free DexScreener discovery + selective Nansen enrichment. Goal: productive signals without burning credits on noise. Production system: live trading via launchd. Ralph writes to project copy; Mr. V reviews and deploys.

userStories.title: Write PROJ-solana-v2-redesign.md - design document
userStories.description:
Current state: PROJ-solana-v2-redesign.md does not exist.

What to build: Create PROJ-solana-v2-redesign.md in the project root (businesses/horizen-zkverify/) as the design + context document for this PRD. Include:

1. Problem statement: v1 pipeline produces 98% zero-score signals; Nansen-first discovery finds tokens after SM accumulation, missing the early pump
2. Design principle: 'Earn the expensive data' - free discovery first, Nansen only for tokens that look promising
3. New architecture:
   - Tier 1 (free): DexScreener /latest/dex/pairs/solana sorted by liquidity+volume+newest, cached 15 min
   - Tier 2 (free): hard filters - 3-30 day age, $50K+ liquidity, $100K+ volume
   - Tier 3 (optional): Nansen smart-money/netflow page cross-ref (5 cr, cached 4h)
   - Tier 4: momentum-first scoring (no SM signal required to pass)
4. Credit budget: ~30 cr/day (vs. v1 ~60 cr for noise)
5. Config changes: min_token_age 30->3, min_liquidity 100K->50K, disable flow_intel

Constraints:
- Do NOT modify any .py files - this is a design doc only
- Write to businesses/horizen-zkverify/PROJ-solana-v2-redesign.md

userStories.title: scanner.py - DexScreener-first token discovery
userStories.description:
Current state: load_candidate_tokens() in scanner.py (line ~123) uses Nansen smart-money/netflow as primary discovery source. It calls Nansen, then filters by age>=30 days. This misses new Solana tokens before SM accumulation.

What to change: Replace the discovery logic in load_candidate_tokens() with DexScreener-first discovery.

New implementation:
1. Check DISCOVERY_CACHE_FILE (path already exists: data/solana_discovery_cache.json). TTL already set to 14400 (4h) -- reduce to 900 (15 min). Change DISCOVERY_CACHE_TTL = 900.
2. On cache miss: call DexScreener GET https://api.dexscreener.com/latest/dex/pairs/solana
3. Parse response: for each pair extract baseToken.address, baseToken.symbol, quoteToken.symbol, liquidity.usd, volume.h24, marketCap, priceUsd, createdAt
4. Filter:
   - Skip if quoteToken.symbol != 'SOL' (only SOL pairs)
   - Skip stablecoins (USDC/USDT/USDS/USD1/PYUSD/DAI/BUSD/TUSD by symbol)
   - Skip if liquidity < 50000 USD
   - Skip if marketCap < 50000 USD
   - Skip if marketCap > 100000000 USD
   - Skip if token age (from createdAt) < 3 days
   - Skip if token age > 30 days
   - Skip if volume.h24 < 100000 USD
5. Sort by: liquidity DESC, then volume.h24 DESC
6. Return up to 25 candidates as dicts with keys: symbol, address, chain='solana', liquidity_usd, market_cap_usd, price_usd, volume_24h_usd, token_age_days (computed from createdAt), dex_score (liquidity rank 0-1 normalized)
7. Save to disk cache
8. If DexScreener call fails, fall back to Nansen smart-money/netflow (keep existing Nansen path as fallback)

Keep: get_flow_intelligence() unchanged. _headers() unchanged. get_sol_price_usd() unchanged. get_btc_5h_change() unchanged. DISCOVERY_CACHE_FILE path unchanged.

Constraints:
- Do NOT remove get_flow_intelligence() -- it is still used by run_pipeline.py
- Do NOT change FLOW_CACHE_FILE or FLOW_CACHE_TTL
- Use requests (already imported) -- do not add new dependencies
- Sys.path.insert not needed -- scanner.py is run from scripts/ directory directly
acceptanceCriteria: python3 -c "import sys; sys.path.insert(0,'businesses/horizen-zkverify/solana-trader/scripts'); from scanner import load_candidate_tokens; print('imports OK')"

userStories.title: scanner.py - Nansen netflow cross-ref function
userStories.description:
Current state: after SV2-002, scanner.py has DexScreener discovery. No Nansen cross-reference exists yet.

What to build: Add a new function load_nansen_netflow_crossref() that fetches Nansen smart-money/netflow for Solana and cross-references with DexScreener candidates.

New function:
def load_nansen_netflow_crossref(top_n: int = 10) -> dict:
    '''Fetch Nansen Solana netflow rankings and return as dict: address -> netflow_24h_usd.
    Used to cross-reference DexScreener candidates against SM rankings.
    Cached to disk at data/nansen_netflow_cache.json with TTL = 14400 (4h).
    Returns {} if NANSEN_API_KEY not set or API fails.'''
    - Check NANSEN_API_KEY -- if not set, return {}
    - Check/cache pattern: data/nansen_netflow_cache.json, TTL = 14400
    - On cache miss: POST to NANSEN_BASE/api/v1/smart-money/netflow
      body: {'chains': ['solana'], 'filters': {'include_stablecoins': False, 'include_native_tokens': False}, 'pagination': {'page': 1, 'per_page': 50}, 'order_by': [{'field': 'net_flow_24h_usd', 'direction': 'DESC'}]}
    - Parse response: return {token_address_lower: net_flow_24h_usd for each item}
    - 5 credits per call
    - Cost: ~30 cr/day (6 cache misses x 5 cr)

Also add to load_candidate_tokens() after DexScreener discovery:
    - Call load_nansen_netflow_crossref() to get SM rankings
    - For each candidate, attach nansen_netflow_usd = sm_rank.get(address_lower, 0)
    - Add nansen_rank field: 0 if not in Nansen top 50, else rank position (1=best)

Constraints:
- Do NOT call Nansen more than once per cache refresh (share across candidates)
- NANSEN_API_KEY check: if not in os.environ, skip Nansen entirely and continue with DexScreener-only candidates
- Do NOT modify get_flow_intelligence()
acceptanceCriteria: python3 -c "import sys; sys.path.insert(0,'businesses/horizen-zkverify/solana-trader/scripts'); from scanner import load_nansen_netflow_crossref; print('function exists')"

userStories.title: signal_filter.py - momentum-first Solana scoring
userStories.description:
Current state: signal_filter.py has score_signal() using 4 pillars (SM Netflow 100pts, Flow Intel 100pts, Volume 100pts, Token Health 100pts). Hard disqualifier requires SM signal. On Solana v1, 98% of tokens score 0 because SM signal is absent.

What to change: Create a new function score_signal_solana() with momentum-first weights.

New scoring function score_signal_solana(token, flow_intel, btc_change, config):
  Input token dict now includes (from DexScreener): symbol, address, liquidity_usd, market_cap_usd, volume_24h_usd, token_age_days, dex_score, nansen_netflow_usd, nansen_rank

Pillars (total 400 pts):
  P1 - Momentum (150 pts max): based on DexScreener data
    - liquidity_score (50 pts): liquidity 50K->10M maps to 0-50 linearly
    - volume_score (50 pts): volume 100K->10M maps to 0-50 linearly
    - price_momentum (50 pts): if priceChange.h24 exists, 0-50 based on 0%->50% change
  
  P2 - SM Signal (100 pts max): from Nansen netflow crossref
    - If nansen_netflow_usd > 0 and nansen_rank > 0: (1 - nansen_rank/50) * 100
    - Else: 0 (no SM disqualifier -- SM is bonus, not requirement)
  
  P3 - Market Cap Fit (100 pts max):
    - $1M-$10M: 100 pts (sweet spot for pumps)
    - $10M-$50M: 70 pts
    - $50M-$100M: 30 pts
    - <$1M or >$100M: 0 pts
  
  P4 - Flow Intelligence (50 pts max): from get_flow_intelligence()
    - If flow_intel available: min(50, smart_trader_wallet_count * 10)
    - Else: 0

Hard disqualifiers (return score 0, passes=False):
  - BTC 4h change < -3% (macro kill switch)
  - liquidity_usd < 50000
  - token_age_days < 3 or > 30

Soft disqualifiers (reduce score but don't block):
  - volume_24h_usd < 100000: halve final score

Entry threshold: 175/400 (same as v1)

Keep score_signal() unchanged for backward compatibility (Base Trader may call it).

Constraints:
- Do NOT modify score_signal() -- only add score_signal_solana()
- Use only token dict fields that SV2-002/SV2-003 will produce
- No new imports needed
acceptanceCriteria: python3 -c "import sys; sys.path.insert(0,'businesses/horizen-zkverify/solana-trader/scripts'); from signal_filter import score_signal_solana; print('function exists')"
python3 -c "import sys; sys.path.insert(0,'businesses/horizen-zkverify/solana-trader/scripts'); from signal_filter import score_signal; print('score_signal unchanged')"

userStories.title: run_pipeline.py - updated pipeline flow for Solana v2
userStories.description:
Current state: run_pipeline.py calls load_candidate_tokens() then for each token calls get_flow_intelligence() then score_signal(). Credit guard at 500 cr causes hard stop.

What to change in run_pipeline.py:

1. Import: add score_signal_solana from signal_filter
2. Change scoring call: use score_signal_solana() instead of score_signal()
3. Remove per-token flow_intel calls: the current loop calls get_flow_intelligence(address) for every candidate. For Solana v2, we ONLY call flow_intel for tokens that pass Tier 2 filters and are in the top 3 by DexScreener ranking. Update the loop:
   - After hard filters, if token not in top_3 by dex_score AND credits < 200: skip flow_intel call
   - Top 3 always get flow_intel if credits >= 100
4. Credit guard: change threshold from 500 to 200 (only gate flow_intel calls, not discovery)
5. Flow intel (get_flow_intelligence) stays available but is only called on top candidates, not all
6. Config changes to read:
   - min_token_age_days: 3 (from config, not hardcoded 30)
   - max_token_age_days: 30 (new config param)
   - min_liquidity_usd: 50000 (from config)
   - flow_intel_enabled: true (new config param -- skip flow_intel calls if false)

Keep: get_sol_price_usd(), get_btc_5h_change(), positions/load_positions(), buy/sell logic, notification logic, credit tracking.

Constraints:
- Do NOT modify execute.py or decision.py
- Do NOT change the paper_trade logic
- Keep credit logging unchanged

What to change in config.yaml:

Add these params:

  max_token_age_days: 30      # new -- cap to avoid old tokens
  min_liquidity_usd: 50000    # was 100000 -- lower to catch more candidates
  min_volume_24h_usd: 100000   # new -- filter dead tokens
  max_market_cap_usd: 100000000  # was 500000000 -- cap to stay in pump range

  credit_guard_min: 200         # new -- skip flow_intel below this threshold

Change existing:
  min_market_cap_usd: 50000   # was 5000000 -- lower to $50K (dexscreener already filters)

Constraints:
- Do NOT change paper_trade, stop_loss_pct, tier1_pct, tier2_pct, max_positions, position_size_usd -- these are working correctly
